announcements.headline: PDMR Dealings
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms that persons discharging managerial responsibilities have engaged in share transactions, which is a routine regulatory disclosure. It provides transparency into insider activity but does not inherently signal a change in corporate strategy or financial performance.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Dealing
announcements.insight: Standard regulatory disclosure of individual director transactions which typically carries negligible signal for institutional investors compared to aggregate insider buying/selling trends or board-level strategy shifts.

announcements.headline: Director / PDMR Dealing
announcements.insight: Routine director dealing announcements typically carry minimal market impact unless they signal a coordinated shift in insider sentiment; without volume or price context, this is classified as administrative noise rather than a strategic signal.

announcements.headline: Exercise of Options / PDMR notification
announcements.insight: Exercise of options by a PDMR is a standard administrative event indicating no immediate change in beneficial ownership or strategic direction. Without context on the size of the exercise or the specific director's role, this lacks the materiality to influence market sentiment or valuation.
